name: s07-frontend-artifact-compare
command:
import pathlib,hashlib,json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence=root/"docs/releases/evidence-v1.1.19"
record=(evidence/"s07-node20-pnpm9-build.txt").read_text()
work=pathlib.Path(next(line.split("=",1)[1] for line in record.splitlines() if line.startswith("isolated_work=")))
def manifest(base):
 return {str(p.relative_to(base)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in base.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
local=manifest(root/"backend/internal/web/dist")
ci=manifest(work/"backend/internal/web/dist")
different=sorted(name for name in set(local)|set(ci) if local.get(name)!=ci.get(name))
print(json.dumps({"local_file_count":len(local),"node20_file_count":len(ci),"different_paths":different,"artifacts_equal":not different},indent=2))
assert not different
